brief:
Israeli forces shot at a girl and a young man in Gaza, with an additional young man also targeted by gunfire, Wafa reported. The incidents occurred as Israeli military operations continued across the territory. Artillery shelling also struck the northwest of Rafah city during the same period.

In a separate incident in the northern Gaza Strip, a child was wounded in Jabalia refugee camp. The exact circumstances surrounding each shooting and the current condition of those injured remain unclear. The reports add to a mounting toll of casualties as military operations persist across Gaza.
dek: Israeli forces shoot at girl, two young men in Gaza Israeli forces shot at a girl and a young man in Gaza and targeted the northwest of Rafah city with artillery shelling, Wafa reported. In Jabalia refugee camp in the northern Gaza Strip, a child was wounded…
title: Israeli forces shoot girl, two young men in Gaza
